python -c "
import urllib.request, zipfile, os, shutil
# Download data.tar.gz which contains separate cath4.2 and cath4.3 datasets
url = 'https://github.com/A4Bio/ProteinInvBench/releases/download/dataset_release/data.tar.gz'
tpath = '/tmp/_data.tar.gz'
print('Downloading data.tar.gz...')
urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, tpath)
import tarfile
with tarfile.open(tpath, 'r:gz') as tar:
    tar.extractall('/tmp/_data_tmp')
os.remove(tpath)
# Copy cath4.2 and cath4.3 data separately
for d in ['cath4.2', 'cath4.3']:
    src = f'/tmp/_data_tmp/data/{d}'
    dst = f'/workspace/data/{d}'
    if os.path.isdir(src):
        for f in os.listdir(src):
            shutil.copy2(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join(dst, f))
        print(f'{d}: {os.listdir(dst)}')
shutil.rmtree('/tmp/_data_tmp')
print('CATH data downloaded (separate 4.2 and 4.3)')
"

python -c "
import urllib.request, zipfile, os, shutil
url = 'https://github.com/A4Bio/ProteinInvBench/releases/download/dataset_release/TSDataset.zip'
zpath = '/tmp/_ts.zip'
print('Downloading TSDataset.zip...')
urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, zpath)
with zipfile.ZipFile(zpath) as zf:
    names = zf.namelist()
    print(f'  Archive contains {len(names)} files')
    for n in names:
        print(f'    {n}')
    zf.extractall('/tmp/_ts_tmp')
os.remove(zpath)
# Find and copy json files to /workspace/data/ts/
import glob
for f in glob.glob('/tmp/_ts_tmp/**/*.json', recursive=True):
    dst = os.path.join('/workspace/data/ts', os.path.basename(f))
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    print(f'Copied {f} -> {dst}')
shutil.rmtree('/tmp/_ts_tmp')
print('TS data ready:', os.listdir('/workspace/data/ts'))
"
